decisive_items: dozens of 1–2 cm oedematous pink-red papules with a darker red-violet central zone
Infiltrate of atypical mononuclear cells around vessels
Vascular damage with extravasated erythrocytes, leucocytoclasia, and fibrinoid degeneration
response.rationale: The clinical presentation and histopathological findings are more consistent with Sweet syndrome, but the presence of myeloblasts and abnormal localization of immature precursors suggests a possible underlying myelodysplastic syndrome.

rejected.why: Elevated IgA and presence of atypical mononuclear cells are not specific enough to support Chronic Myelomonocytic Leukemia as the primary diagnosis.
